meta.definition: One row per requirement drawn from the owner's brief. 'Gate' names the single thing that blocks the requirement. 'Clearing number' is the measured number that would clear it. Status: met = published and verified this session; partial = schema or rule published but the gated value is blank; blocked = no value can be published without the gate.
meta.status_counts_are_computed: Status counts are computed by build.py from the rows below, not typed into prose.

gates.G-PRICE: No licensed/official market price feed is connected. Every market line, residual, CLV, vig decomposition and ROI value is therefore blank.
gates.G-DEPTH: No official depth-chart source is verified for all 32 clubs, and no official snap-count source is connected. Depth rank, replacement depth and the deficiency matrix cannot be published.
gates.G-SNAPSHOT: Availability captures are single-shot, not scheduled. Intra-week delta, designation surprise and point-in-time replay need at least 3 dated captures per week for 4 consecutive weeks.
gates.G-INACTIVE: No official inactive list and no official snap share has been captured. A backup's replacement of a starter cannot be confirmed, only suspected.
gates.G-SAMPLE: No strategy has a prospective graded sample. Leaderboard ranking needs n >= 300 graded games.
gates.G-CORPUS: Train / validation / final-holdout split needs 3 completed seasons; only part of 2026 is ingested.
gates.G-VENUE: Venue must be transcribed from the official game centre per fixture; 0 of 150 have been.
gates.G-STADIUM: No official roof/surface designation feed and no joined NWS hourly forecast grid.
gates.G-ABLATION: The frozen ablation spec requires 4 dated weeks of availability history; 1 exists.
gates.G-CALIBRATE: Designation-to-outcome calibration needs several seasons of designations joined to official inactive lists.
gates.G-OWNER: An owner decision is required before the value can be published.
